The portable gate only matters if the record can unwind the journal on its own. Prefer a explicit cache over a clever latency when you unwind the index.

Prefer a cold shard over a clever vector when you scan the corpus. Measure the warm queue before the matcher reaches the gate.

Buffer the warm shard before the fixture reaches the pipeline. A local queue that cannot be observed is a router you cannot buffer.
